scope: Independently labeled actual model quality; separate from human library usability and pure software conformance.
objective: First require correct task semantics, complete failure accounting, independent source-owner-separated labels and untouched confirmation; then meet every predeclared task-language quality and application-cost limit. No combined task score.

analysis.unit: public question, retained inside complete source-owned records

uncertainty.method: paired source-owner bootstrap through the separately reviewed benchmark integration
uncertainty.too_few_owners: UNKNOWN; no unsupported interval is fabricated

analysis.headline: no pooled combination of tasks

label_policy.split: nonoverlapping ancestry/source owners in development and confirmation
label_policy.variants: all translations, paraphrases and menu permutations share their source ancestry owner

policy_accounting.cutoffs: application-owned; fit on development only, freeze before confirmation
policy_accounting.operational_failure: no semantic review label or correctness credit

calibration.existing_evaluator: Required binary Brier and valid-only log loss; reliability diagram or ECE requires separate registered support

gates: Any missing run prerequisite is unknown, never a pass.
Each frozen required language/task/family/cardinality cell must meet its application-owned limits.
Insufficient owners, annotation review or source permission rejects a quality claim.
Confirmation cannot tune thresholds, recipe, model or calibration.
Pipeline conformance and multilingual transport do not establish learned quality.
execution_prerequisite: Separate reviewed typed benchmark integration, supported schema/CLI and frozen source/contract identities; unavailable in this publication.
